title: ANDREA DatasetManifest
description: Run-time manifest for GRN inference. Describes the embedded dataset spec, expression matrix path, and optional extra artefacts. This is the main orchestrator input.

dataset.description: Core dataset inputs (embedded semantic spec + expression matrix path).

genes.description: Number of rows (genes). Rows are always genes by definition.

expression_profile.description: Statistical nature of the expression matrix (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, mixed, or unknown).

gene_id_kind.description: Identifier kind used for gene names in rows.

taxonomic_group.description: Broad taxonomic group used for tool compatibility checks.

ncbi_taxon_id.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID (e.g., 9606 human, 10090 mouse). Null is allowed for synthetic or unknown datasets.

context.description: Optional biological context (free text or IDs). Useful for enrichment/prior integration in future versions.

disease.description: Disease/condition label or ID (e.g., 'acute myeloid leukemia' or 'MONDO:0018874').

tissue.description: Tissue/source label or ID (e.g., 'bone marrow' or 'UBERON:0002371').

cell_type.description: Cell type label or ID (e.g., 'B cell' or 'CL:0000236').

expression_matrix.description: Path to expression TSV. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/expression_matrix.json.

extras.description: Optional extra artefacts (paths) that some tools may consume. Use null when not provided.

groups.description: Optional groups TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/groups.json.

cell_phenotypes.description: Optional ordered cell phenotype TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/cell_phenotypes.json.

cell_descriptors.description: Optional cell descriptor TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/cell_descriptors.json.

chromatin_accessibility_matrix.description: Optional paired chromatin accessibility matrix TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/chromatin_accessibility_matrix.json.

cluster_identities.description: Optional cluster identity TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/cluster_identities.json.

cluster_markers.description: Optional cluster marker TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/cluster_markers.json.

enrichment_background.description: Optional enrichment background gene-list path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/enrichment_background.json.

grnboost_network.description: Optional precomputed GRNBoost2 network TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/grnboost_network.json.

lineage_tree.description: Optional lineage tree TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/lineage_tree.json.

pseudotime.description: Optional pseudotime TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/pseudotime.json.

terms_of_interest.description: Optional terms-of-interest list path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/terms_of_interest.json.

tf_list.description: Optional TF list text file path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/tf_list.json.

prior_grn.description: Optional global prior GRN TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/prior_grn.json.

prior_grn_by_group.description: Optional group-specific prior GRN TSV path. Detailed content validation is defined in input_specs/prior_grn_by_group.json.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about this manifest/run.
